description: Finds thoughts by meaning. Call it when looking for something by description rather than exact title — for instance to check whether a thought on this topic already exists. Always pass variants: several phrasings of the same concept (synonyms, translation, a broader and a narrower term). They raise recall noticeably, and if the semantic index is not built they are all that works.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

includeAuxiliary.description: Include types and tags in results. By default only ordinary thoughts.

query.description: What you are looking for, in your own words.

variants.description: Other phrasings of the same concept: synonyms, a translation into the second language, a broader and a narrower term. Three to six of them, at most 10.

name: brain_search
